name: Turing Hall
blurb: The main lecture building, where Intro to Programming is taught. Long hallways lined with numbered lockers. Day Jay is the TA here.

name: Oracle Hall
blurb: The administration building, donated by the Oracle family. President Fortran's office is upstairs. The student council works out of the second floor, and the basement runs the campus servers.

name: Lovelace Library
blurb: Tall shelves, reading lamps, and big west windows. Open in the Day slot, plus late nights during finals week.

name: Knuth Hall
blurb: Home of the computer science department, named after Donald Knuth. The lab is in the basement, the project rooms are upstairs, and a fire door at the top of the stairwell opens onto the roof.

name: Student Union
blurb: The loud, busy building on the west edge of campus. Clubs, events, and the best sunset on campus.

name: Main Quad
blurb: The open center of campus: a big lawn, a fountain with benches, and a sunny hill up toward the library. Hosts orientation, the club fair, and the end-of-term festival.

name: Observatory
blurb: A small domed building on the hill at the east edge of campus, away from the lights.

name: The Commons
blurb: Food and shopping, all under one roof next to the dorms. Short hours during Thanksgiving break.

name: Babbage Hall
blurb: The heroine's dorm. Quack talks to her here every night.

name: Greenhouse and Gardens
blurb: Monty's corner of campus: a glass greenhouse, winding garden paths, and a small pond.

name: Athletic Complex
blurb: The gym and the running track around the athletic field.
